---
title: Fish Ravioli
id: MAR-0092
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 55
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g flour
- 400 g baked fish
- 300 g Swiss chard
- 100 g ricotta
- 2 dl tomato sauce
- 1 egg
- to taste salt
## Method
1. To prepare the pasta, arrange the flour in a fountain with a pinch of salt, pour 1 dl of water in the center and knead until you get a smooth and homogeneous mixture.
2. Clean the Swiss chard, rinse them and cook them in very little lightly salted water for 5 minutes; drain them, squeeze them and chop them.
3. Chop the fish flesh and collect it in a bowl with the Swiss chard, the ricotta, the egg and a pinch of salt and mix the ingredients.
4. Roll out the pasta; place the filling in small balls on half of the sheet, spaced about 3-4 cm apart, then cover with the remaining pasta, press with your fingers around the balls and, with a fluted wheel, cut out the ravioli.
5. Cook them in salted boiling water, drain them and season them with the tomato sauce.
